title: The Awakened
summary: Mages: people who have woken to their power to remake reality.

claims.text: Awakened is the common word for mages, and also for other Night-Folk with paranormal gifts.
Awakening is waking to one's power to rework reality and work True Magick.
A Sleeper has not yet Awakened; a Sleepwalker has awareness and perhaps odd talents but no Sphere magick.

title: The Avatar
summary: The inner god that guides a mage.

claims.text: An Awakened Avatar is the inner god that guides a mage and lets the mage rework reality.
The Seeking is the Avatar-led inner quest for further enlightenment.

title: Arete
summary: Enlightened Will: the measure of a mage's magickal excellence.

claims.text: Arete is the excellence and Enlightened Will that lets a mage change reality.
It is said ahr-eh-TAY or AIR-eh-tay; a knowing mage never says Arr-REET.
Raising Arete costs its current rating times eight in experience.

title: The Consensus
summary: Reality as most people agree it is.

claims.text: The Consensus is reality as most people agree on it; the Technocracy holds it to be humanity's ideal, safe state.
Consensual reality, or Earthly reality, is the world as most humans understand and experience it.
Reality Zones are optional: they may set what is coincidental, be ignored in favour of a Technocratic world, or let players shift paradigms.

title: Coincidental and Vulgar Magick
summary: Magick that hides inside chance, and magick that does not.

claims.text: Coincidental magick could pass as natural chance to an unbelieving witness; it works within the dominant paradigm.
Within some reality zones, some kinds of magick are more coincidental than others.

title: Paradox
summary: The backlash of conflicting realities.

claims.text: Paradox is the force of clashing realities, raised when a mage works magick badly or pushes past the Consensus.
Paradox can wall an offending mage into a small Paradox Realm, cut off from consensual reality.
Marauders are not quite immune to Paradox: their madness shields them, and the backlash tends to strike others.

title: Quintessence
summary: The Fifth Essence of Creation.

claims.text: Quintessence is the raw essence of Creation, also called Primal Force, shown in Patterns through Dynamism and Stasis.
Tass is Quintessence in physical form, taking a shape suited to its source, such as toadstools in a glade or blood in a creature.
Nodes are knots of primal energy where Quintessence wells up and Tass forms, often at places of strong emotion, harmony or corruption.

title: Ascension
summary: Transcendence, for the self and for humanity.

claims.text: Ascension is rising to a higher state, both for the mage alone and for humanity as a whole.
Few mages agree what Ascension looks like.

title: The Council of Nine Mystic Traditions
summary: The alliance of the nine mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Council of Nine Mystic Traditions is the full name of the united Traditions, and also of their leadership.
The Order of Hermes is the largest and most organised Tradition.

title: Akashic Brotherhood
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Akashayana seek harmony in a chaotic world, training the body to cultivate the mind and the Sphere of Mind.
The Council often misreads them as peaceful warriors.

title: Celestial Chorus
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Chorus hears the voice of the Divine, the One, by whatever name, whose Song all beings can join to shape Creation.
Choristers teach that the Song has many harmonies, reached through many creeds.

title: Cult of Ecstasy
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: Ecstatics teach five steps: surrender fear, focus intent, open, attune, and begin again.
A mentor and student bind themselves in a covenant called Diksham.

title: Dreamspeakers
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Dreamspeakers gather shamans from across the world to rebuild their roots.
A technoshamanic movement is growing in the spirit side of the Digital Web.

title: Euthanatos
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Euthanatoi see themselves as keepers of the Wheel.
Mages of the good death are often cast as murderers, since the will to live is strong.

title: Order of Hermes
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Order of Hermes is the largest and best organised Tradition and shaped Western magick.
Hermetics hold vast wealth, potent Wonders and great libraries.

title: Society of Ether
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: Etherites claim descent from ancient Troy, with natural philosophy rooted among the pre-Socratic Greeks.
Few outside the Tradition accept the claim to Troy.

title: Verbena
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: The Verbena see life as a vast cycle, a dance of elements no mage can escape.
That view frightens most people, and many Verbena like it that way.

title: Virtual Adepts
summary: One of the Nine Mystic Traditions.

claims.text: Virtual Adepts hold that everything can be represented as information.
Crack the code of a thing and you can change, improve or delete it, without touching it.

title: The Technocratic Union
summary: The Technocracy: the union of science-led mages that guards the Consensus.

claims.text: Capitalised, Technocracy is short for the Technocratic Union, and a Technocrat is one of its members.
Some Technocrats hold religious faith; Iteration X's devotion to The Machine is a vision of God.

title: Iteration X
summary: A Convention of the Technocratic Union.

claims.text: Iteration X venerates The Machine.

title: New World Order
summary: A Convention of the Technocratic Union.

claims.text: The New World Order holds that the Masses are safest kept asleep, with deviance hidden and science predictable.

title: Progenitors
summary: A Convention of the Technocratic Union.

claims.text: The Progenitors would reshape organic life into a better strain by mastering and remaking its principles.

title: Syndicate
summary: A Convention of the Technocratic Union.

claims.text: The Syndicate may be the most powerful group on Earth, though rumour paints its operatives as gangsters.

title: Void Engineers
summary: A Convention of the Technocratic Union.

claims.text: The Void Engineers defend humanity against everything beyond the Gauntlet, from aliens to spirits.

title: Hollow Ones
summary: Orphaned mages outside both Council and Technocracy.

claims.text: A Hollow One keeps quiet about allies among the Bata'a, since bragging could cost those allies their lives.

title: Nephandi
summary: Fallen mages of the Path of Descent.

claims.text: Nephandi are dark-reflection mages on the Path of Descent, known for corruption and deceit.
The Fallen rarely show themselves; outside their lowest ranks they seem to be someone or something else.

title: Marauders
summary: Mages lost in their own reality.

claims.text: Marauders see reality so far from the Consensus that they live in their own reality wells.
Each Marauder lives out reality as that Marauder sees it, a case of Dynamism gone too far.
